The names above describe the target module. Inventory-specific implementation classes are intentionally deferred until the inventory design is approved.

docs.title: 5.1 Store
docs.text:
Table: store

Field Type Required Description id int Yes Internal primary key uuid string(36), unique Yes Stable public/cross-service identifier code string(50), unique Yes Immutable machine-readable store code name string(255) Yes Current display name status string(30) Yes active, suspended, closed timezone string(64) Yes IANA zone, such as Asia/Shanghai contact json nullable No Sanitized contact data address json nullable No Structured address/geolocation data settings json nullable No Store-local configuration, not secrets — see §5.1.1 createdAt datetime_immutable Yes Creation time updatedAt datetime_immutable nullable No Last update

Rules:

  • uuid is the only cross-service store identifier.
  • code is stable after activation because Promotion and external channels may use it.
  • closed stores cannot be selected for new orders.
  • Historical orders use snapshots, so Store deletion is forbidden; closure is a status.

docs.title: 5.1.1 Store Settings Schema (single flow, default false)
docs.text:
settings is validated by Store/Resources/JsonSchema/StoreSettings.json (via Manage/StoreController + Core/Validator/JsonSchemaValidator) and parsed by Store/DTO/StoreSettings. Unknown top-level keys are tolerated for forward compatibility. Only fulfillment verification remains; order.requireAcceptance has been removed.

{
  "fulfillment": { "requireVerification": false }
}
Key Type Default Effect fulfillment.requireVerification bool false false → Trade fulfilled --complete--> completed directly (_completionMode=manual). true → Trade fulfilled can only complete via Store verification (_completionMode=store_verification). StoreOrder.verificationRequired is snapshotted at creation; Trade completion is gated by Trade/EventListener/OrderCompletionGuardListener (blocks complete unless Order::allowCompletionFromStoreVerification() has been called) and Trade/EventListener/OrderVerificationCompletionListener (auto-completes after fulfill if _storeVerificationReceived=true). Store side: POST /store/{scopeId}/orders/{uuid}/verify (StoreOrderService::verify → store.order.verified.v1 → Trade/MessageHandler/StoreOrderVerifiedHandler).

Validation:

  • settings must be object|null; fulfillment must be object|null when present.
  • fulfillment.requireVerification must be bool when present.
  • null or missing settings is treated as false (legacy stores).
  • The value is snapshotted per order into TradeOrder.metadata._store.requireVerification, TradeOrder.metadata._completionMode, and StoreOrder.verificationRequired at trade.order.created.v1 time. Changing Store.settings after order creation does not affect inflight orders (immutable per-order verification requirement).

Example — enable verification:

curl -X PUT http://localhost:8080/api/v1/manage/stores/{uuid} \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"settings":{"fulfillment":{"requireVerification":true}}}'

docs.title: 5.1.2 Store Address / Contact Schemas (standardized via JSON Schema)
docs.text:
address and contact are validated in the API layer before processCreateContent via Core/Validator/JsonSchemaValidator driven by CreateApiViewMixin/UpdateApiViewMixin ($jsonSchemas). Schemas live in src/Store/Resources/JsonSchema/; validator lives in Core.

// Manage/StoreController
protected array $jsonSchemas = [
    'address'  => 'Store/StoreAddress',
    'contact'  => 'Store/StoreContact',
    'settings' => 'Store/StoreSettings',
];
  • StoreAddress.json — province/city/district/street/detail/building/floor/postalCode/formattedAddress (strings, maxLength), latitude [-90,90] + longitude [-180,180] (number) with dependencies: latitude↔longitude, geohash regex, poiId; type: object, additionalProperties:false, null skipped (field is nullable). Extra keys → 400.
  • StoreContact.json — phone/managerPhone regex, email/managerEmail format:email, managerUserUuid format:uuid, wechat/serviceHours; additionalProperties:false.
  • StoreSettings.json — fulfillment.requireVerification (bool, default false); top-level additionalProperties:true for forward compat, inner fulfillment additionalProperties:false. No order key; order.requireAcceptance was removed.

All json columns remain nullable; the schemas provide the API contract while preserving the current 1w-store json storage and Cache-based distance calculation (no latitude/longitude columns yet). Violations throw JsonSchemaViolationException → 400.

docs.title: 5.2 Membership
docs.text:
Table: store_membership

Field Type Required Description id int Yes Internal primary key store ManyToOne Store Yes Local Store relation userUuid string(36) Yes Identity User UUID scalar; no foreign key role string(30) Yes owner, manager, clerk, fulfillment status string(30) Yes active, suspended, revoked createdAt datetime_immutable Yes Grant time updatedAt datetime_immutable nullable No Last update

Constraints and rules:

  • Unique (store_id, user_uuid).
  • Index (user_uuid, status) for authorization lookup.
  • A membership role is local to one Store and MUST NOT be written into Identity\User.roles.
  • ROLE_ADMIN remains a platform-wide override; Store membership supports store-scoped operations only.

docs.title: 5.3 StoreOrder
docs.text:
Table: store_order

StoreOrder is the Store-side aggregate created from one Trade order-created event. It is not a second commercial order.

Field Type Required Description id int Yes Internal primary key uuid string(36), unique Yes Store order public identifier tradeOrderUuid string(36), unique Yes Immutable Trade order reference store ManyToOne Store Yes Local Store relation storeCodeSnapshot string(50) Yes Code at placement time storeNameSnapshot string(255) Yes Name at placement time customerUserUuid string(36) nullable No Scalar customer Identity UUID reference currency string(10) Yes Copied for display/validation totalAmount bigint Yes Immutable copied commercial amount in cents orderSnapshot json Yes Immutable line and delivery snapshot from event operationalStatus string(40) Yes Store operational state machine rejectionCode string(50) nullable No Machine-readable rejection reason rejectionReason text nullable No Sanitized operator/customer reason acceptedAt datetime_immutable nullable No Store acceptance time rejectedAt datetime_immutable nullable No Store rejection time fulfillmentData json nullable No Pickup/delivery/assignment data, Store-owned reservationId string(64) nullable No Future inventory reservation reference verificationRequired bool Yes Immutable snapshot of settings.fulfillment.requireVerification at projection time (from trade.order.created.v1 store.requireVerification). Default false. Controls whether verify is allowed. verifiedAt datetime_immutable nullable No Store verification time (set by POST /store/{scopeId}/orders/{uuid}/verify; requires verificationRequired=true and operationalStatus=fulfilled) verifiedBy string(36) nullable No Verifying staff userUuid (audit) createdAt datetime_immutable Yes Projection creation time updatedAt datetime_immutable nullable No Last update

Indexes:

Index Purpose Unique trade_order_uuid Business idempotency: one StoreOrder per Trade order (store_id, operational_status, created_at) Store work queue and reporting (customer_user_uuid, created_at) Customer read views (reservation_id) Future inventory reconciliation

totalAmount, currency, and orderSnapshot are copied facts for Store operations. Trade remains authoritative if they ever differ; a mismatch is an alert-worthy contract violation, not a Store-side repricing opportunity.

docs.title: 5.4 Store Operational Statuses
docs.text:
Status Meaning Owner pending_validation Event received; Store checks eligibility (transient, immediately accepted when INVENTORY_ENABLED=0) Store awaiting_inventory Store validated; reservation pending (only when INVENTORY_ENABLED=1) Store/Inventory integration accepted Projection accepted (auto-accepted when INVENTORY_ENABLED=0); Store can fulfill Store rejected Reserved for future inventory rejection path only Store fulfillment_pending Commercial payment complete; Store may prepare work Store fulfilling Store is actively preparing/dispatching Store fulfilled Store reports local fulfillment complete Store verified Store verification completed (fulfilled -> verified via POST .../verify); emits store.order.verified.v1 Store cancelled Store operation stopped after Trade cancellation Store

Notes:

  • In the current simplified coupling, pending_validation -> accepted is auto-applied by Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler when INVENTORY_ENABLED=0. No store.order.accepted.v1 / rejected.v1 is emitted.
  • When verificationRequired=true, the only Store verification transition is fulfilled -> verified. Verification is checked against the immutable StoreOrder.verificationRequired snapshot, not live Store.settings.
  • The Store workflow MUST NOT use paid, refunded, or completed as its own state names. Those remain Trade commercial states.

docs.title: StoreOutboxMessage
docs.text:
Table: store_outbox_message

Field Type Description id bigint Internal sequence eventId string(36), unique Globally unique event identifier topic string(120) e.g. store.order.verified.v1 (accepted/rejected removed) aggregateType string(80) store_order aggregateId string(64) StoreOrder UUID payload json Event envelope/payload, safe to serialize occurredAt datetime_immutable Business event time availableAt datetime_immutable Retry scheduling time publishedAt datetime_immutable nullable Delivery acknowledgement time attempts int Relay attempt counter lastError text nullable Sanitized relay error

docs.title: StoreConsumedEvent
docs.text:
Table: store_consumed_event

Field Type Description id bigint Internal sequence eventId string(36), unique Incoming integration event id topic string(120) Original topic aggregateId string(64) Source aggregate id processedAt datetime_immutable Successful local processing time payloadHash string(64) SHA-256 of canonical payload for diagnostics

Inbox uniqueness prevents replayed broker messages from repeating Store decisions. The business unique key on StoreOrder.tradeOrderUuid remains mandatory defense in depth.

docs.title: 6.1 Target States
docs.text:
Trade order workflow is intentionally simple and does not carry a Store acceptance branch. See config/packages/workflow.yaml and src/Trade/Entity/Order.php.

draft -> pending -> confirmed -> paid -> fulfilled -> completed
draft -> cancelled
pending -> cancelled
confirmed -> cancelled
paid -> refunded
fulfilled -> completed
fulfilled -> cancelled
  • There are no awaiting_store_acceptance, store_accepted, store_rejected, awaiting_store_verification, store_submit, store_accept, store_reject, request_verification, or store_verify places/transitions.
  • Trade/Service/OrderService::createOrder always applies submit (draft -> pending) when a StoreContext is present, persists _store + _completionMode into metadata (see §3.2), and always writes a trade.order.created.v1 outbox row.
  • Store verification does not introduce workflow states; it gates the existing fulfilled -> completed transition via guards (see below).

Store verification completion (single optional flow) — fulfillment.requireVerification

fulfillment.requireVerification metadata._completionMode Trade completion behavior false (default) manual fulfilled --complete--> completed directly. No Store verification required. true store_verification fulfilled --complete--> completed only when Order::isCompletingFromStoreVerification()=true. Direct complete is blocked by Trade/EventListener/OrderCompletionGuardListener. Verification fact arrives via store.order.verified.v1 → Trade/MessageHandler/StoreOrderVerifiedHandler (sets _storeVerificationReceived=true and calls allowCompletionFromStoreVerification() → workflow->apply(complete)). Out-of-order case: if verified.v1 arrives before fulfilled, the handler stores _storeVerificationReceived and Trade/EventListener/OrderVerificationCompletionListener auto-completes right after fulfill.

Store side: POST /store/{scopeId}/orders/{uuid}/verify (no verificationCode; UUID is the verification token) checks StoreOrder.isVerificationRequired() (immutable snapshot) and operationalStatus=fulfilled, then transitions fulfilled -> verified and emits store.order.verified.v1 with verifiedBy/verifiedAt.

Invariants:

  1. Trade always emits trade.order.created.v1 when a StoreContext exists, after it has an immutable order UUID and Store snapshot (including requireVerification).
  2. Payment is not gated on Store state. pending -> confirmed -> paid proceeds normally.
  3. Store projection is eventual; TradeOrderCreatedHandler auto-accepts (pending_validation -> accepted) when INVENTORY_ENABLED=0.
  4. Verification consumers are idempotent (StoreConsumedEvent + workflow.can() checks + store-uuid match).
  5. When _completionMode=store_verification, fulfilled cannot complete without the Store verification flag (OrderCompletionGuardListener + OrderVerificationCompletionListener).

docs.title: 6.2 Payment Gate
docs.text: No Store gate exists. The Trade payment service checks standard order.status eligibility (pending, confirmed, etc.). Payment endpoints do not return a conflict for Store-scoped orders awaiting any Store step. This was changed when awaiting_store_acceptance was removed.

docs.title: 6.3 Order Creation Response
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders with X-Store-Code always creates a pending order and returns 201 Order created (even for Store-scoped orders). A trade.order.created.v1 outbox row is always written when StoreContext exists:

{
  "data": {
    "orderUuid": "trade-order-uuid",
    "status": "pending",
    "store": {
      "uuid": "store-uuid",
      "name": "Xuhui Store"
    }
  },
  "code": 201,
  "message": "Order created"
}

The Store projection is created asynchronously; the client polls GET /api/v1/app/store-orders/{uuid} or the Trade order detail endpoint. Store availability does not affect the HTTP status; unavailable Store handling is via async retry/DLQ (see §8.1).

For completion: fulfilled --complete--> completed is direct when fulfillment.requireVerification=false (_completionMode=manual). When true (_completionMode=store_verification), the client/staff must trigger POST /store/{scopeId}/orders/{uuid}/verify and the Trade order auto-completes on store.order.verified.v1 (see §7.5 and §8.1).

docs.title: 7.1 Envelope
docs.text:
All integration events use this envelope:

{
  "eventId": "uuid",
  "type": "trade.order.created",
  "version": 1,
  "occurredAt": "2026-07-24T12:00:00+00:00",
  "aggregateType": "trade_order",
  "aggregateId": "trade-order-uuid",
  "correlationId": "trade-order-uuid",
  "causationId": null,
  "payload": {}
}

Rules:

  • eventId is immutable and globally unique.
  • aggregateId is the aggregate UUID, never an internal database id.
  • correlationId follows the business flow across services; for this flow it begins as the Trade order UUID.
  • causationId is the triggering event id, or null for an initial HTTP command.
  • A breaking payload change creates a new event version/topic; it never mutates v1.
  • Payloads must contain only data safe for the receiving domain. Do not publish secrets, payment credentials, raw provider callbacks, or unnecessary PII.

docs.title: 7.2 trade.order.created.v1
docs.text:
Publisher: Trade outbox relay after order creation commits.

Consumer: Store TradeOrderCreatedHandler (Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler).

{
  "orderUuid": "trade-order-uuid",
  "store": {
    "uuid": "store-uuid",
    "code": "shanghai-xuhui",
    "name": "Xuhui Store",
    "channel": "mini_program",
    "requireVerification": false
  },
  "customerUserUuid": "identity-user-uuid",
  "currency": "CNY",
  "totalAmount": 12800,
  "items": [
    {
      "lineId": "trade-order-item-uuid",
      "catalogReference": "SKU-001",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unitPrice": 6400,
      "lineAmount": 12800,
      "snapshot": {}
    }
  ],
  "delivery": {},
  "placedAt": "2026-07-24T12:00:00+00:00"
}
  • store.requireVerification is the snapshot of Store.settings.fulfillment.requireVerification at order creation (see §3.2, §5.1.1, §6.1). Store persists it as StoreOrder.verificationRequired; Trade persists it as metadata._store.requireVerification and derives metadata._completionMode.

The event is a historical placement snapshot. Store does not re-read Trade tables to complete the payload.

docs.title: 7.3 store.order.accepted.v1 — Removed
docs.text:
Removed in the simplified coupling. The Store no longer emits store.order.accepted.v1. StoreOrder is auto-accepted synchronously in Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler when INVENTORY_ENABLED=0; when INVENTORY_ENABLED=1 it enters awaiting_inventory and future inventory confirms it. No store_accept workflow transition exists. Historical payload for reference:

{
  "orderUuid": "trade-order-uuid",
  "storeOrderUuid": "store-order-uuid",
  "storeUuid": "store-uuid",
  "acceptedAt": "2026-07-24T12:01:00+00:00",
  "reservationId": "inventory-reservation-uuid"
}

docs.title: 7.4 store.order.rejected.v1 — Removed
docs.text:
Removed in the simplified coupling. The Store no longer emits store.order.rejected.v1. Rejection reasons below are retained only as a future inventory-rejection vocabulary; Trade does not consume a Store rejection event and does not transition to cancelled from a Store event.

Previously allowed reasonCode values:

Code Meaning STORE_NOT_FOUND Resolved Store no longer exists; indicates configuration drift STORE_UNAVAILABLE Suspended, closed, or not accepting the channel ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE Store cannot sell one or more requested items OUT_OF_STOCK Inventory reservation rejected DELIVERY_NOT_SUPPORTED Delivery method/address not serviceable ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT Store decision did not arrive before the Trade deadline SYSTEM_ERROR Retry budget exhausted; operator action required

docs.title: 7.5 Implemented Verification Event
docs.text:
store.order.verified.v1 (Store → Trade) is implemented when the order's snapshotted verificationRequired=true (i.e. Store.settings.fulfillment.requireVerification=true at order creation time, metadata._completionMode=store_verification).

{
  "orderUuid": "trade-order-uuid",
  "storeOrderUuid": "store-order-uuid",
  "storeUuid": "store-uuid",
  "verifiedBy": "staff-user-uuid",
  "verifiedAt": "2026-09-03T08:00:00+00:00"
}
  • No verificationCode. Verification uses the order UUID as the verification token: POST /store/{scopeId}/orders/{uuid}/verify takes no body (empty JSON {} accepted). The controller resolves the StoreOrder by UUID and verifies membership scope.
  • Preconditions in Store/Service/StoreOrderService::verify(): isVerificationRequired()=true and operationalStatus=fulfilled; otherwise LogicException. On success transitions fulfilled -> verified (StoreOrder::verify() sets verifiedAt/verifiedBy) and records store.order.verified.v1 via store_outbox_message (Store/Service/StoreOutboxService).
  • Consumer: Trade/MessageHandler/StoreOrderVerifiedHandler (async StoreOrderVerifiedMessage). Checks order.metadata._store.uuid === payload.storeUuid and metadata._completionMode === 'store_verification'. Inside a transaction sets metadata._storeVerificationReceived=true, calls Order::allowCompletionFromStoreVerification(), then workflow->can(complete) → workflow->apply(complete) if fulfilled; otherwise the flag remains and Trade/EventListener/OrderVerificationCompletionListener completes after fulfill (out-of-order handling). Idempotent via workflow.can() and repeated flag writes.
  • Audit fields on store_order are verifiedAt/verifiedBy only (see §5.3); verificationCode column was removed.

docs.title: 7.6 Future Events
docs.text:
The following remain reserved:

Event Publisher Purpose trade.order.paid.v1 Trade Allow Store to begin preparation/fulfillment trade.order.refunded.v1 Trade Stop or reverse Store work where allowed store.order.fulfilled.v1 Store Tell Trade fulfillment completed, if Trade retains its workflow transition (currently Store fulfill is local only) inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1 Inventory Confirm Store-requested reservation inventory.reservation.rejected.v1 Inventory Reject Store-requested reservation

trade.order.cancelled.v1 is already implemented (Trade OrderWorkflowListener on cancel).

docs.title: 8.1 Trade Order Created Consumer
docs.text:
Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler (TradeOrderCreatedMessage) processes one message as follows:

receive message (trade.order.created.v1)
  -> validate envelope and schema version (eventId + payload)
  -> start Store local transaction
  -> insert StoreConsumedEvent(eventId), or return if already present (inbox dedup)
  -> find Store by payload.store.uuid; if not found or not active, throw RuntimeException
     (triggers Messenger retry; not a business rejection)
  -> create/find StoreOrder by tradeOrderUuid via StoreOrderService::createFromTradeOrderSnapshot
     (includes verificationRequired snapshot from payload.store.requireVerification;
      idempotent on duplicate tradeOrderUuid with same snapshot; LogicException on mismatch)
  -> if StoreTradeOrderCancellation exists for this tradeOrderUuid -> StoreOrder.cancel()
  -> if StoreOrder.operationalStatus != pending_validation -> return (already handled)
  -> if !INVENTORY_ENABLED -> StoreOrderService::accept() (pending_validation -> accepted, no outbox)
  -> else -> StoreOrder.awaitInventory(reservationId) + StoreOutboxService.record('inventory.reservation.requested.v1')
  -> commit
  -> acknowledge broker message

No store.order.accepted.v1 / rejected.v1 is emitted. The unavailable-Store path throws RuntimeException('Store is not available.') so the broker retries rather than committing a rejected projection.

The broker message is acknowledged only after the Store transaction commits. If the process crashes before acknowledgement, the event is delivered again and becomes an inbox/business-idempotent no-op.

docs.title: 8.2 Outbox Publisher
docs.text:
The outbox publisher is a transport adapter, not business logic:

poll unpublished outbox messages in created order
  -> lock one batch
  -> publish envelope to transport topic
  -> mark publishedAt on broker acknowledgement
  -> on transient error: increment attempts and retry later
  -> on retry exhaustion: retain record and alert/DLQ

Initial deployment may use Symfony Messenger with Doctrine transport. The business contract must not depend on that choice. RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, or an HTTP event relay can replace the transport without changing StoreOrder business code.

docs.title: 8.3 Retry Classification
docs.text: Failure Consumer action Duplicate eventId Acknowledge; no mutation (inbox hit) Duplicate tradeOrderUuid, same snapshot Continue idempotently; return existing StoreOrder Duplicate tradeOrderUuid, different snapshot Do not overwrite; throw LogicException → critical alert and DLQ Temporary database/broker failure Roll back and retry Invalid event schema/version DLQ; do not retry blindly (InvalidArgumentException) Store not found / not active Throw RuntimeException('Store is not available.') → retry with backoff (Messenger retry), then DLQ Inventory rejection (future) Commit rejected StoreOrder; inventory DLQ handling to be defined Unexpected domain exception Roll back; retry with bounded backoff, then DLQ

docs.title: 8.4 Ordering And Concurrency
docs.text:
• Store 消费者通过 tradeOrderUuid 通过 必要时有唯一的 StoreOrder 密钥和事务锁定。
  • 事件主题应在传输支持的情况下保留每个聚合键的排序 它，但正确性不能依赖于全局排序。
  • 交易后的商店验证fulfilled是唯一的跨捆绑结果事件； store.order.verified.v1 通过 _storeVerificationReceived + workflow.can(complete) 实现幂等。
  • 交易取消由 Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCancelledHandler (StoreTradeOrderCancellation + StoreOrder.cancel()) 消耗，确保忽略后期验证。
  • 所有结果处理程序在应用转换之前都会验证预期的源状态。

docs.title: 9.1 公共商店发现
docs.text:
方法 路径 授权 目的 获取 /api/v1/app/stores 可选/ROLE_USER 按频道 发现精选活跃商店 获取 /api/v1/app/stores/{uuid} 可选/ROLE_USER 按频道 查看商店详细信息和库存情况

这些端点不创建订单。店面使用选定的商店上下文 调用现有的交易报价/订单 API 时。

docs.title: 9.2 客户商店订单读取视图
docs.text:
方法 路径 授权 目的 获取 /api/v1/app/store-orders/{uuid} ROLE_USER 阅读自己商业订单的商店运营信息

控制器通过 StoreOrder 中存储的 customerUserUuid 解析所有权。 不得泄露运营记录、员工 ID、库存内部情况或内部信息 排斥诊断。

API是方便读取的模型；客户仍然使用贸易订单 API 付款、取消、退款和规范的商业状态。

docs.title: 9.3 平台商店管理
docs.text: 方法 路径 授权 目的 获取/发布/放置 /api/v1/manage/stores 角色管理员 存储增删改查；关闭而不是删除 获取/发布/放置 /api/v1/manage/store-memberships 角色管理员 分配/撤销商店会员资格 获取 /api/v1/manage/store-orders 角色管理员 跨店运营报告 获取 /api/v1/manage/store-orders/{uuid} 角色管理员 操作细节

docs.title: 9.4 店员操作
docs.text:
商店工作人员不得使用通用 Trade manage/orders 路线，该路线是整个平台范围内的 ROLE_ADMIN端点。 Store 提供范围化的操作端点：

方法 路径 所需会员资格 目的 获取 /api/v1/store/manage/orders 活跃会员 当前商店工作队列 获取 /api/v1/store/manage/orders/{uuid} 活跃会员 StoreOrder操作详情 发布 /api/v1/store/manage/orders/{uuid}/fulfill 履行/经理/所有者 (store:order:fulfill) 标记存储操作 fulfilled（本地转换；已完成 -> 已完成）。如果 _storeVerificationReceived 已经为 true，则触发 OrderVerificationCompletionListener 自动完成。 发布 /api/v1/store/{scopeId}/orders/{uuid}/verify 履行/经理/所有者 (store:order:verify) 完成后存储验证 — 需要 StoreOrder.isVerificationRequired()=true（快照，非实时设置）和 operationalStatus=fulfilled；主体为空（{}）；使用订单 UUID 作为验证令牌。转换 fulfilled -> verified 并发出 store.order.verified.v1 和 verifiedAt/verifiedBy（无 verificationCode）。 Staff userUuid 取自经过身份验证的 Identity 用户。

POST .../accept 和 POST .../reject 已被删除。商店验收是自动的；拒绝被推迟到未来的库存。

所有操作都会根据 StoreOrder 的本地 Store 关系检查成员资格，而不是请求提供的商店标识符。 fulfill/verify 是幂等守卫：如果不是 fulfilled 或不是 verificationRequired，verify 会失败并返回 LogicException。

docs.title: 10.1 角色
docs.text: 校长 范围 能力 ROLE_ADMIN 平台 所有商店管理和报告 商店 owner 一间店 会员、商店设置、履行、验证 商店 manager 一间店 履行、验证、操作视图 商店 clerk 一间店 读取操作队列；有限的配置操作 商店 fulfillment 一间店 仅限履行的运营行动 客户 自有订单 仅读取客户安全的 StoreOrder 视图

docs.title: 10.2 授权规则
docs.text:
1. 平台角色存在于身份中并保留其现有含义。
  2. 存储角色仅存在于Membership中。
  3. Store 控制器将经过身份验证的 Identity 用户解析为标量 userUuid 并 查询 在本地存储成员资格。
  4. ROLE_ADMIN 仅在明确的管理路由上绕过成员资格检查。
  5. 商店工作人员无法直接提升贸易订单的商业状态。
  6. 商店员工操作（fulfill、verify）产生商店事件；贸易仅通过 StoreOrderVerifiedHandler + OrderCompletionGuardListener/OrderVerificationCompletionListener 和工作流程防护应用商业 complete。

docs.title: 11. 商店背景和促销合同
docs.text:
促销目前在交易的价格计算上下文中使用 storeCode。的 商店捆绑包为该值提供了权威来源：

request -> StoreContextResolver -> active Store -> StoreContext.storeCode
        -> Trade calculatePrices(..., storeCode, ...)
        -> Promotion storeCode filtering

规则：

  • 客户不能通过发布storeCode来选择任意促销商店。
  • Trade 将解析器生成的代码传递到定价管道。
  • 商店快照与订单创建事件一起保存，以便商店消费者可以 验证订单的定价是否适用于预期商店。
  • 促销保持独立：它不引用存储表或实体。
  • 全球促销仍以现有的空商店代码约定为代表； 商店选择决不能无意中将一个不知名的商店变成全球定价。

这种设计使现有的Promotion.storeCode成为路由输入，而不是Store 领域模型或授权机制。

docs.title: 12. 库存边界
docs.text:
库存被故意排除在第一个商店数据模型之外。商店定义了 它需要的命令/结果边界：

Store validates order (TradeOrderCreatedHandler)
  -> if INVENTORY_ENABLED=0: auto-accept (pending_validation -> accepted), no inventory event
  -> if INVENTORY_ENABLED=1:
       inventory.reservation.requested.v1
       -> Inventory reserves quantity idempotently
       -> inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1  -> StoreOrder.accept()
            or inventory.reservation.rejected.v1 -> StoreOrder.reject()

未来的请求负载必须包括：

  • reservationId：存储生成的幂等性/引用 UUID。
  • storeUuid。
  • tradeOrderUuid和storeOrderUuid。
  • 商品库存键、数量和不可变的关联 ID。
  • 预订到期/截止日期。

商店拥有请求预订的决定权并保留结果reservationId。 库存拥有可用数量、预留分类账、减量/释放和库存 和解。两个模块都不会访问对方的数据库。

docs.title: 13.1 接受超时
docs.text:
Trade 在创建订单时记录可配置的接受截止日期。预定的 贸易工作发现订单在截止日期后仍在等待商店接受，并且：

  1. 应用取消转换。
  2. 将trade.order.cancelled.v1写入交易发件箱，原因为ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT。
  3. Store消费cancel，将其挂起的操作标记为已取消，并询问future 库存以释放任何预订。

该作业必须是幂等的：终端或已接受的订单将被忽略。

docs.title: 13.2 迟到的事件
docs.text: 迟到的活动 所需行为 交易超时取消后商店接受 贸易忽略它并记录相关性；商店发布取消活动相关工作 交易取消后商店拒绝 贸易忽视了它；商店保留被拒绝的审核记录 商店等待库存时取消交易 商店将取消标记为待处理，并在已知后释放预订 接受前的付款事件 贸易拒绝/标记为不变违约；付款开始必须已被控制

docs.title: 13.3 无分布式回滚
docs.text: 一旦事件跨越发件箱边界，远程突变就无法回滚。 补偿表示为新的业务事件和本地状态转换，而不是 跨服务数据库事务。

docs.title: 14.1 初始存储迁移
docs.text:
存储迁移仅创建存储拥有的表：

store
store_membership
store_order
store_outbox_message
store_consumed_event

它可能包括来自 store_membership.store_id 和 store_order.store_id 的外键 到本地 store 表。它不得将外键添加到 users、trade_order、 payment_invoice，或未来的库存表。

docs.title: 14.2 贸易移民
docs.text: 单独的贸易迁移仅添加所需的通用订单编排数据 新的工作流程，例如现有 trade_order.metadata JSON 中的存储快照 (_store)、_completionMode 和 _storeVerificationReceived。不添加接受截止日期字段或 Store FK。

docs.title: 14.3 数据回填
docs.text:
对于没有商店元数据的现有订单：

  • 将它们视为遗留/全球订单。
  • 除非存在可靠的外部映射，否则不要伪造StoreOrder记录。
  • 现有的付款/退款行为保持不变。
  • 简化的预测（自动接受）和验证门 (_completionMode) 仅适用于此更改后新创建的商店范围订单。

docs.title: 15.1 错误类别
docs.text: 类别 HTTP/事件行为 记录 无效的商店上下文 交易创建订单前拒绝 带有安全存储提示的警告 商店不可用（未找到/未激活） 消费者抛出 RuntimeException('Store is not available.') → 重试/DLQ storeUuid/tradeOrderUuid/尝试警告 事件架构违规 DLQ 事件 ID/主题错误 消费者瞬态故障 重试 尝试计数警告 快照不匹配（tradeOrderUuid 与 storeCode/verificationRequired/amount 冲突） 不要改变现有的 StoreOrder；抛出 LogicException → 严重警报 严重警报 验证前提条件失败（!verificationRequired 或 status != fulfilled） 来自 StoreOrderService::verify 的 HTTP 409/422 storeOrderUuid/verificationRequired/status 警告 发件箱发布失败 重试/DLQ 聚合/事件 ID 错误

docs.title: 15.2 必需的结构化日志字段
docs.text:
所有异步路径包括：

eventId, topic, aggregateId, correlationId, causationId,
tradeOrderUuid, storeOrderUuid, storeUuid, attempt

Logs must not contain customer phone/address details, payment secrets, raw gateway payloads, or complete item snapshots unless explicitly redacted for secure diagnostics.

docs.title: 15.3 Operational Metrics
docs.text:
The target deployment exports at least:

  • Outbox backlog count and oldest unpublished age.
  • Consumer lag by topic.
  • StoreOrder creation count by Store (auto-accept vs awaiting_inventory).
  • Verification count by Store (verified status).
  • Fulfillment-to-completion latency (manual vs store_verification).
  • Inbox duplicate count.
  • DLQ count and oldest message age.

docs.title: 16.1 Unit Tests
docs.text: Suite Required cases tests/Store/Entity/ Store lifecycle, membership role/status, StoreOrder snapshots/statuses/verificationRequired, outbox/inbox fields tests/Store/Service/ Context resolution, membership authorization, Store verify/fulfill guards (verificationRequired, fulfilled status), snapshot matching tests/Store/Consumer/ Valid event (auto-accept), duplicate event, duplicate business key same/different snapshot, schema error, unavailable Store throws RuntimeException tests/Store/Outbox/ Publish retry classification and event envelope serialization tests/Trade/ Order submit always creates pending + outbox; OrderCompletionGuardListener blocks/permits complete; StoreOrderVerifiedHandler + OrderVerificationCompletionListener out-of-order handling

docs.title: 16.2 Integration Tests
docs.text: Scenario Expected result Active Store receives valid Trade event (INVENTORY_ENABLED=0) One accepted StoreOrder, no Store outbox (auto-accept) Active Store with requireVerification=true StoreOrder.verificationRequired=true snapshotted; Trade metadata._completionMode=store_verification Store is closed / not found Consumer throws RuntimeException('Store is not available.') → retry/DLQ; no StoreOrder committed Same eventId redelivered No second StoreOrder or outbox event (inbox dedup) Different event ids with same Trade UUID/same payload One StoreOrder; idempotent Same Trade UUID/different payload (e.g. different requireVerification or amount) No overwrite; LogicException → critical/DLQ Store staff reads another store order 404/403 without information leak Customer reads another customer's StoreOrder 404/403 without information leak Store fulfill then verify (verificationRequired) StoreOrder fulfilled -> verified + store.order.verified.v1; Trade fulfilled -> completed Store verify before Trade fulfilled (out-of-order) Trade stores _storeVerificationReceived=true; OrderVerificationCompletionListener completes after fulfill Trade fulfilled -> complete without verification when store_verification Blocked by OrderCompletionGuardListener (409/conflict) Store verify when verificationRequired=false or status != fulfilled 409/422 LogicException

docs.title: 16.3 Contract Tests
docs.text:
Event producers and consumers need contract fixtures stored independently of Doctrine serialization. Tests validate:

  • Required fields and scalar types.
  • v1 event compatibility.
  • Unknown optional field tolerance.
  • Forbidden sensitive fields absent from payload.
  • Stable canonical payload hashing for inbox diagnostics.

docs.title: Phase 1: Store Foundation
docs.text:
1. Create Store, Membership, StoreOrder, Outbox, and Inbox entities/repositories.
  2. Add Store service interfaces and services.
  3. Implement platform Store administration and membership management.
  4. Implement StoreContext resolution for the selected channel.
  5. Add Store discovery endpoints and Store-staff authorization tests.

docs.title: Phase 2: Trade Orchestration Contract
docs.text:
1. Simplify Trade workflow to draft -> pending -> confirmed -> paid -> fulfilled -> completed (remove acceptance states).
  2. Add server-generated Store snapshot (_store + _completionMode + _storeVerificationReceived) to new Trade orders.
  3. Add a generic Trade integration-event outbox abstraction.
  4. Always publish trade.order.created.v1 when a StoreContext exists, after the Trade transaction commits; draft -> pending via submit.
  5. Return 201 (pending) for Store-scoped order creation (no 202).
  6. Preserve legacy order behavior when no Store context is present, only if that legacy mode remains a product requirement.

docs.title: Phase 3: Store Consumer And Decision Events
docs.text:
1. Implement Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler with inbox and business idempotency.
  2. Create StoreOrder from immutable event snapshot (including verificationRequired).
  3. Auto-accept (pending_validation -> accepted) when INVENTORY_ENABLED=0; otherwise request inventory reservation (awaiting_inventory).
  4. Retries on unavailable Store via RuntimeException (no rejection event).
  5. Implement StoreOrderService::fulfill / verify and store.order.verified.v1 outbox.
  6. Implement Trade/MessageHandler/StoreOrderVerifiedHandler + OrderCompletionGuardListener / OrderVerificationCompletionListener (including out-of-order handling).

docs.title: Phase 4: Fulfillment And Inventory Integration
docs.text:
1. Define Inventory reservation event contracts.
  2. Gate Store acceptance on reservation confirmation.
  3. Add Store fulfillment operations and corresponding Trade event consumers where commercial workflow transitions remain Trade-owned.
  4. Add cancellation/release compensation.

docs.title: Phase 5: Service Extraction Readiness
docs.text:
1. Move event schemas to a versioned contract package or JSON schema repository.
  2. Replace in-process transport with a broker while retaining Outbox/Inbox behavior.
  3. Move Store database and consumer independently.
  4. Run consumer-driven contract tests in CI.
  5. Add replay tooling and operational dashboards before enabling production extraction.

docs.title: 18. Acceptance Criteria
docs.text:
The Store bundle design is implemented when:

Criterion Requirement Single order entry No Store endpoint creates a commercial order; Trade remains the entry point Store isolation Store has no Doctrine association/FK to Trade, Payment, Identity, or Inventory Context integrity Store identity comes from a server-resolved StoreContext, not client body fields Store projection Exactly one StoreOrder is created per Trade order UUID, idempotently Event isolation Integration event payloads are versioned scalar/JSON contracts, never Doctrine entities Reliable publication Business mutation and local outbox write share one transaction Reliable consumption Inbox event-id uniqueness and StoreOrder business uniqueness protect retries Payment gate No Store gate; Trade payment eligibility is standard (no awaiting_store_acceptance block) Rejection/timeout No Store rejection event / acceptance timeout; unavailable Store is retried via DLQ, not cancelled Verification gate When fulfillment.requireVerification=true, fulfilled -> completed requires store.order.verified.v1 (immutable per-order snapshot, verificationRequired + _completionMode) Authorization Store membership scopes fulfill/verify; platform admin retains explicit override Inventory boundary Store has reservation contract hooks but no embedded inventory ledger Extraction readiness Store can move to a separate database/consumer with no cross-schema joins or transactions

docs.title: 贸易捆绑设计
docs.text: 交易包 (src/Trade/) 拥有订单、订单项目、价格计算和 基于 Symfony Workflow 的订单状态机。产品和规格归 Store（src/Store/Entity/Product.php、src/Store/Entity/Specification.php、 保留表 trade_product/trade_specification) 并可空 store (NULL = 共享/全局）；参见Store Catalog Model。 Trade 仍然是 商业订单权限并通过标量快照引用商店目录 StoreContext。

docs.title: 1. 概述
docs.text:
Trade提供完整的订单管理系统：

  • 商店目录集成与 Store 产品和规格（类似 SKU 的变体，Product.store 对于共享/全局可为空）
  • 订单 具有状态机生命周期（草稿 -> 已完成）
  • 订单商品带有价格快照以确保历史准确性
  • 价格计算管道：具有优先级排序的可插入计算器（在 BasePriceCalculator 中强制执行商店可见性）
  • 软删除：产品和规格使用 isDeleted 标志（商店实体）
  • UUID v4：订单和商品的外部标识符
  • 商店集成：商店范围的订单写入本地发件箱事件并创建 StoreOrder 投影

docs.title: 1.1 目录所有权
docs.text: 产品和规格是 Store 实体（Product.store 可为空）。目录读取、报价和订单需要 StoreContext (X-Store-Code → Store)； BasePriceCalculator 仅接受已解析商店的共享 (store IS NULL) 或商店拥有的规范。请参阅Store Catalog Model。

docs.title: 1.2 实体
docs.text: 实体 表 目的 Store\Product trade_product 可销售产品，包含名称、描述、状态、可为空 store Store\Specification trade_specification 产品变体（名称、美分价格、状态） Order trade_order 带有状态机、总计、货币的采购订单 OrderItem trade_order_item 包含 specificationUuid（标量）、specificationTitle、快照、数量、单价的订单项 TradeOutboxMessage trade_outbox_message 交易整合事件接力记录

docs.title: 1.2 商店范围订单（可选，默认关闭）
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders 仍然是唯一的客户订单入口点。值得信赖的 X-Store-Code 由 Store 捆绑解析为 Trade-owned 标量 StoreContext；贸易永远不会导入商店实体。订单始终收到 _store 元数据快照和 _completionMode （manual 或 store_verification 快照来自 Store.settings.fulfillment.requireVerification）。订单通过submit进入pending 无论 Store 是否存在，并且在出现时始终写入 trade.order.created.v1 StoreContext 存在。

app:trade:outbox:publish 通过 Messenger 调度事件。商店消耗它 幂等地，创建其 StoreOrder 投影（带有 verificationRequired 快照），并且， 当库存被禁用时，立即自动接受。店铺验证 (store.order.verified.v1) 是唯一的商店到交易完成信号并应用 通过 Trade/EventListener/OrderCompletionGuardListener 和 Trade/EventListener/OrderVerificationCompletionListener。 Trade/EventListener/OrderWorkflowListener 对于 completed 来说是状态驱动的，而不是 硬编码存储转换名称。状态列为VARCHAR(40)。

docs.title: 3. 实体关系
docs.text:
Store\Product (status: active/inactive, isDeleted: bool, metadata: JSON, store: ?Store)
  |
  +-- 1:N -> Store\Specification (cascade: persist)

Store\Specification (name, price: int cents, status, sort, isDeleted)
  |  inherits Product.store visibility
  +-- (no FK) -> Trade\OrderItem via scalar specificationUuid + snapshots

  |
  +-- M:1 -> User
  +-- 1:N -> OrderItem (cascade: persist)

docs.title: 4.1 产品
docs.text:
• UUID v4 供外部参考
  • status：active或inactive
  • isDeleted：软删除标志
  • metadata：JSON可扩展字段

docs.title: 4.2 规格
docs.text:
• 属于产品
  • price 以美分为单位（整数，在 API 边界与小数相互转换）
  • status：活动/非活动
  • sort：手动排序
  • isDeleted：软删除标志

docs.title: 4.3 顺序
docs.text:
• UUID v4
  • totalAmount 以分为单位
  • currency：默认CNY
  • status：状态机标记字段（草稿/待定/已确认/已付款/已完成/已完成/已取消/已退款）
  • cancelledAt、completedAt：由OrderWorkflowListener设置
  • items：级联持久化

docs.title: 4.4 订单项目
docs.text:
• UUID v4
  • unitPrice：订购时规格价格的快照（美分）
  • price：unitPrice * quantity，在#[ORM\PrePersist]中自动计算
  • cost、profit：用于保证金跟踪
  • specSnapshot、productSnapshot：创建历史记录时捕获的 JSON 快照

docs.title: 5.1 合同
docs.text:
interface PriceCalculatorInterface
{
    public function calculate(PriceCalculationContext $context): void;
    public static function getPriority(): int;
}

docs.title: 5.2 计算器链（优先顺序）
docs.text:
优先 计算器 模块 责任 -100 -100 BasePriceCalculator 贸易 解析规范实体、验证活动/未删除、提取单价、捕获快照 50 QuantityCalculator 贸易 计算每个项目的 price = unitPrice * quantity 55 TotalAggregator 贸易 在促销评估之前建立小计 60 PromotionCalculator 促销 DSL 评估 → 匹配 → 应用（最多 20 次迭代、应用 ID 跟踪、独占/锁定项目/最佳价格冲突模式）

外部模块（例如，Promotion、未来的Coupon）通过实现PriceCalculatorInterface并使用#[AutoconfigureTag('trade.price_calculator')]进行标记来挂钩到管道中。贸易对这些模块的认知度为零。

docs.title: 5.3 管道执行
docs.text:
OrderService::calculatePrices($items, $currency)
  -> Collect all PriceCalculatorInterface implementations (auto-tagged)
  -> Sort by getPriority() ascending
  -> Execute each in sequence on PriceCalculationContext
  -> Return PriceCalculationResult (items, totalAmount, currency)

docs.title: 5.4 管道执行
docs.text:
OrderService::calculatePrices($items, $currency, $storeCode = null, $meta = [])
  -> Create PriceCalculationContext with items, currency, user, storeCode, meta
  -> Collect all PriceCalculatorInterface implementations (auto-tagged)
  -> Sort by getPriority() ascending
  -> Execute each in sequence on PriceCalculationContext
     (BasePriceCalculator → QuantityCalculator → TotalAggregator → PromotionCalculator)
  -> Return PriceCalculationResult (items, totalAmount, currency, meta)

docs.title: 5.5 个 DTO
docs.text:
class PriceCalculationContext
{
    public array $inputItems;     // Raw input from request
    public array $items;          // Mutated by calculators
    public int $totalAmount;      // Final total in cents
    public string $currency;      // e.g., 'CNY'
    public array $meta = [];      // Bidirectional opaque channel for calculators
    public ?object $user = null;  // Current user (for member-level conditions)
    public ?string $storeCode = null; // Multi-store routing
}

class PriceCalculationResult
{
    public int $totalAmount;
    public string $currency;
    public array $items;          // Calculated order items
    public array $meta;           // From context.meta (carries promotion/coupon results)
}

docs.title: 5.6 meta 渠道合约
docs.text:
meta 是 Trade 从不检查的不透明数组。计算器从中读取作为输入 并将其写入作为输出。合同是：

方向 示例 设置者 客户端→计算器 {coupon: {code: "ABC123"}} 请求正文 → calculatePrices($items, $currency, $storeCode, $meta) 计算器 → 客户端 {promotion: {inner: [...], outer: {...}}} PromotionCalculator 写入 context.meta['promotion'] 任意键均可共存 {promotion: {...}, coupon: {...}, existing: "..."} 多种计算器

保证： - Trade 永远不会读取或改变 meta 内容 - 它会保持不变。 - PriceCalculationResult::fromContext() 将 context.meta 逐字复制到结果中。 - 新模块（例如优惠券）遵循相同的模式：实现PriceCalculatorInterface， 从context.meta['coupon']读取，写入context.meta['coupon']。

docs.title: 5.7 注册
docs.text:
计算器通过 config/services.yaml 自动发现和标记：

services:
  App\Trade\Service\Pricing\:
    resource: '../src/Trade/Service/Pricing/'
    tags: ['trade.price_calculator']

可以通过实现该接口来添加新的计算器——无需更改其他代码。

docs.title: 6.1 配置
docs.text:
文件：config/packages/workflow.yaml — 交易拥有订单生命周期。商店不添加 交易地点或过渡。商店验证是 complete 上的 Trade-owned 守卫。

framework:
  workflows:
    order:
      type: state_machine
      marking_store: { type: method, property: status }
      places:
        - draft
        - pending
        - confirmed
        - paid
        - fulfilled
        - completed
        - cancelled
        - refunded
      transitions:
        submit:   draft -> pending
        confirm:  pending -> confirmed
        pay:      confirmed -> paid
        fulfill:  paid -> fulfilled
        complete: fulfilled -> completed  # guard: _completionMode == store_verification requires Store verification
        cancel:   [draft, pending, confirmed] -> cancelled
        refund:   paid -> refunded

守卫住在Trade/EventListener/OrderCompletionGuardListener（读作Order.metadata._completionMode）。 普通手动订单和没有 _completionMode 的旧订单仍然是允许的。

docs.title: 6.2 有效转换
docs.text: 来自 至 过渡名称 当 草稿 待定 submit 总是 待定 确认 confirm 确认 付费 pay 付费 履行 fulfill 履行 已完成 complete manual 总是； store_verification 仅通过商店验证事实 草案/待定/确认 取消 cancel 付费 已退款 refund

docs.title: 6.3 工作流监听器
docs.text:
class OrderWorkflowListener
{
    // On cancel/pay/fulfill/refund/complete -> set timestamps per transition
    // On complete -> set completedAt + dispatch OrderCompletedEvent
}

docs.title: 7. 订单创建流程
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/orders
  Body: {items: [{specification: {id: N}, quantity: N}, ...], currency: "CNY", notes: "...", meta: {coupon: {...}}}
  |
  v
OrderService::calculatePrices($items, $currency, $storeCode, $meta)
  -> Create PriceCalculationContext(items, currency)
  -> Set context.user, context.storeCode, context.meta = $meta
   -> Price Calculation Pipeline (Base → Quantity → TotalAggregator [subtotal] → Promotion)
   -> Returns PriceCalculationResult (items, totalAmount, currency, meta)
  |
  v
OrderService::createOrder($calculatedItems, $user, $totalAmount, $currency, $notes)
  -> Within transaction:
     -> Create Order entity
     -> For each calculated item: create OrderItem
        -> Snapshot spec + product data
        -> Auto-calculate price = unitPrice * quantity (PrePersist)
     -> Persist + flush
  -> Returns Order entity

docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders/quote

  |
  v
OrderService::calculatePrices($items, $currency, $storeCode, $meta)

Response:

    totalAmount: 8000,
    currency: "CNY",
    meta: {

    }
  }
}

docs.title: 钱包捆绑设计
docs.text: 钱包包 (src/Wallet/) 提供用户钱包、交易、原子 具有防止死锁和幂等性的钱包到钱包转账， 系统存款、余额验证、对账和 付款发票的钱包余额付款调整。

docs.title: 1. 概述
docs.text:
钱包是一个用于管理用户余额的金融模块：

  • 钱包 每个用户每种货币的余额以美分为单位，悲观锁定 (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) + 手动 version 计数器（无 #[ORM\Version]）、冻结功能以及可用/持有余额分离
  • 通过 referenceId 进行具有 UUID、类型分类、状态跟踪和幂等性的 交易
  • TransferService 具有钱包到钱包的原子传输、死锁预防和回滚恢复
  • 存款系统注入资金端点，带有审计跟踪
  • 余额验证 — GET /api/v1/manage/wallets/balance 检查不变式：SUM(wallets) == SUM(deposits + adjustments)
  • 对账 — POST /api/v1/manage/wallets/reconcile 修复了每个钱包的差距
  • 支付调整提供商 — 在外部支付网关处理剩余发票金额之前扣除钱包余额

docs.title: 1.1 会计模型
docs.text:
deposit (TYPE_DEPOSIT)     → injects money from system (one-sided credit)
adjustment (TYPE_ADJUSTMENT) → reconciliation fix (one-sided credit)
transfer (TYPE_TRANSFER)   → zero-sum between wallets (debit + credit)

不变：始终SUM(all wallet balances) == SUM(all deposit + adjustment transactions)。

docs.title: 1.2 实体
docs.text: 实体 表 目的 Wallet wallet 每种货币的用户余额（美分）、冻结支持、乐观锁定 Transaction wallet_transaction 存款/取款/转账/手续费/退款/调整记录 PaymentDeduction wallet_payment_deduction 钱包自有发票钱包余额扣除审计记录

|-- Repository/

|   |-- TransactionRepository.php  # + getTotalDeposited(), getExpectedBalance()

|-- Service/

    |   |-- WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider.php # Implements Payment adjustment provider
    |   |-- WalletGateway.php                    # Implements Payment gateway

    |-- Withdraw/
    |   |-- WithdrawService.php          # Voucher-backed withdrawal + reversal

docs.title: 3.1 钱包
docs.text:
领域 类型 详情 id 整数 自增PK user 多对一 -> 用户 钱包主人 currency 字符串(32) 帐户单位代码（见下文） balance int（bigint） 总计余额（以美分为单位）(balance = available + held) held int（bigint） 冻结金额以美分为单位；可用余额 = balance - held version 整数 手动版本计数器（FOR UPDATE锁定下的SET version = version + 1）；没有 #[ORM\Version] status 字符串 active 或 frozen label 字符串 人类可读的钱包名称

⚠️ 没有 setBalance() / 没有公共 held setter — 钱包余额和持有只能通过 TransferService 更改（转账、存款、持有、释放、对账）。这可以防止直接突变绕过审计跟踪。

可用与持有：balance 是总数； held 资金被冻结（托管、待提款）。 available = balance - held。 TransferService::transfer() 和 hold() 仅针对可用余额进行操作。持有不会更改总余额，也不会写入分类帐行 - 持有会在内部可用和持有的存储桶之间移动资金，因此对账 (SUM(balance) == deposits - withdrawals) 不受影响。持有的审计记录属于拥有的生命周期实体（例如WalletWithdrawal），而不是分类账。

唯一约束：(user_id, currency)——每个账户每个用户一个钱包。

帐户代码单位：currency 是帐户鉴别符，而不是严格的 ISO 4217 代码。简单的 ISO 代码（例如 CNY、USD）标识默认余额钱包；扩展代码（例如 CNY.ESCROW、CNY.COMMISSION、POINTS）标识托管帐户、佣金或积分等类别帐户。默认余额钱包必须使用纯 ISO 代码 - 发票付款解析 (findByUserAndCurrency(payerId, invoice.currency)) 依赖于此，并且绝不能与类别帐户匹配。如果稍后需要外汇或每种货币报告，请引入显式的基础货币列，而不是解析这些代码。

方法：isActive(): bool、isFrozen(): bool

docs.title: 3.2 交易
docs.text:
领域 类型 详情 id 整数 自增PK uuid 字符串(32) UUID v4c 供外部参考 fromWallet ManyToOne -> 钱包（可为空） 源码钱包 toWallet ManyToOne -> 钱包（可为空） 目的地钱包 amount int（bigint） 金额（美分） type 字符串 deposit、withdrawal、transfer、fee、refund、adjustment、credit_reversal、debit_reversal status 字符串 pending、completed、failed、reversed referenceId 字符串（唯一） 幂等性密钥 description 字符串 人类可读的注释 metadata JSON 可扩展数据

唯一约束：referenceId——防止重复交易。

方法：markCompleted()、markFailed()

单边语义（契约）：fromWallet/toWallet null 是有意义的，而不是错误。

Movement shape Meaning fromWallet = wallet, toWallet = wallet Internal transfer (zero-sum, both sides present) fromWallet = null, toWallet = wallet Single-sided credit — funds enter the wallet system from outside, backed by a wallet_voucher (deposit) fromWallet = wallet, toWallet = null Single-sided debit — funds leave the wallet system (withdrawal, or credit_reversal of a deposit)

A deposit MUST write fromWallet = null; a reversal/withdrawal MUST write toWallet = null. A transfer MUST have both sides. Anything else is a contract violation. credit_reversal reverses a credit (deposit) with a single-sided debit; debit_reversal reverses a debit (withdrawal) with a single-sided credit.

Two-layer ledger (contract): wallet movements and boundary events are recorded separately and must not be conflated.

Layer Table Answers Read by Internal (movement journal) wallet_transaction How each wallet's balance changed getExpectedBalance(walletId) — per-wallet reconciliation Boundary (provenance) wallet_voucher Why funds entered/left the system (fund_source, created_by, reversal state) Boundary invariant — verifyBalance()

Both a wallet_transaction AND a wallet_voucher are written for a boundary event. The transaction feeds the unified per-wallet movement journal (internal transfers have no voucher, so the journal cannot be built from vouchers alone); the voucher feeds provenance and the boundary invariant. Removing either breaks the corresponding audit surface.

docs.title: 3.3 PaymentDeduction
docs.text:
Wallet balance deduction for Payment invoices is owned by Wallet because the operation is implemented through wallet balance transfers and reversals.

Table: wallet_payment_deduction

Purpose: record a wallet balance amount applied to a Payment invoice before the selected gateway processes the remaining amount.

Field Type Detail id int Auto-increment PK uuid string(36) Public stable identifier invoiceId string(36) Payment invoice uuid, stored as a lightweight cross-module reference invoiceNo string(64) Payment invoice outTradeNo for lookup/debugging payerId int User id of the payer at deduction time wallet ManyToOne -> Wallet Payer wallet used for deduction systemWalletId int System wallet id that receives deducted funds amount int Deduction amount in cents currency string Must equal invoice currency and wallet currency status string pending, applied, released, refunded, failed walletTransactionId ?string Transfer transaction uuid after deduction is applied reversalTransactionId ?string Transfer transaction uuid after release/refund referenceId string Idempotency key for the apply transfer metadata JSON Sanitized operational metadata createdAt DateTimeImmutable Creation timestamp appliedAt ?DateTimeImmutable Deduction applied timestamp releasedAt ?DateTimeImmutable Unpaid deduction release timestamp refundedAt ?DateTimeImmutable Paid invoice refund timestamp

No ORM relation to Payment invoice: Wallet stores invoiceId and invoiceNo as scalar references. This avoids a hard persistence dependency from Wallet to Payment entities while still allowing audit and lookup.

Unique constraints:

Constraint Requirement uuid Unique referenceId Unique invoiceId Unique for first-phase one wallet deduction per invoice

Status transitions:

pending -> applied -> released
pending -> failed
applied -> refunded

released means the invoice was not paid and the deducted wallet balance was returned. refunded means the invoice was paid and later fully refunded.

docs.title: 4.1 Contract
docs.text:
interface TransferServiceInterface
{
    public function transfer(int $fromWalletId, int $toWalletId, int $amount,
        ?string $referenceId = null, ?string $description = null): TransferResult;

    public function deposit(int $toWalletId, int $amount,
        ?string $referenceId = null, ?string $description = null): TransferResult;
}

docs.title: 4.2 deposit() — System Funding
docs.text:
deposit(toWalletId, amount, referenceId, description)
  |
  v
1. Idempotency Check (via referenceId)
  |
  v
2. Lock target wallet (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE)
  |
  v
3. Validation
   -> amount > 0
   -> wallet exists
   -> wallet not frozen
  |
  v
4. Execute (within DB transaction)
   -> beginTransaction()
   -> DQL UPDATE: toWallet.balance += amount
   -> Create Transaction (type=deposit, fromWallet=null)
   -> commit()
   |
   -> On failure: rollback(), EM recovery
  |
  v
5. Return TransferResult (fromWalletBalance=0)

docs.title: 4.3 Transfer Algorithm
docs.text:
transfer(fromWalletId, toWalletId, amount, referenceId, description)
  |
  v
1. Idempotency Check
  |
  v
2. Lock Wallets (Deadlock Prevention)
   -> Sort wallet IDs ascending
   -> SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on both wallets (in sorted order)
   -> This guarantees consistent lock ordering across concurrent transfers
  |
  v
3. Validation
   -> fromWallet != toWallet (SameWalletTransferException)
   -> fromWallet exists, toWallet exists
   -> fromWallet->isFrozen() || toWallet->isFrozen() (WalletFrozenException)
   -> fromWallet->getBalance() >= amount (InsufficientFundsException)
   -> Currency match: fromWallet->getCurrency() == toWallet->getCurrency()
  |
  v
4. Execute (within DB transaction)
   -> beginTransaction()
   -> DQL UPDATE: fromWallet.balance -= amount
   -> DQL UPDATE: toWallet.balance += amount
   -> transaction->markCompleted()
   -> commit()
   |
   -> On failure: rollback(), transaction->markFailed()
   -> EM recovery: if !$em->isOpen(), recreate EM
  |
  v
5. Return TransferResult
   -> Transaction entity + post-transfer balances

docs.title: 4.4 TransferResult DTO
docs.text:
class TransferResult
{
    public Transaction $transaction;
    public int $fromWalletBalanceAfter;  // 0 for deposits
    public int $toWalletBalanceAfter;    // Post-operation
}

docs.title: 4.5 WithdrawService — Voucher-Backed Withdrawal
docs.text:
WithdrawService is the mirror of deposit: the single gate for funds leaving the wallet system. A withdrawal writes a single-sided debit (fromWallet = wallet, toWallet = null) backed by a DIRECTION_DEBIT voucher. Reversal is its mirror — a single-sided credit (fromWallet = null, toWallet = wallet, type debit_reversal) returning the funds to the source wallet.

withdraw(voucherType, voucherId, walletId, amount, currency, referenceId, createdBy, reason)
  |
  v
1. Validation
   -> amount > 0, referenceId required
   -> Idempotency: findByReferenceId -> return existing voucher
   -> Duplicate source: findByVoucherSource -> reject
   -> Provider whitelist: withdrawRegistry.forVoucherType -> reject unsupported type
  |
  v
2. Within DB transaction (wrapInTransaction)
   -> Lock wallet (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE)
   -> Wallet exists, not frozen, currency matches
   -> available balance >= amount (InsufficientFundsException)
   -> provider.authorize(voucher, options)
   -> DQL UPDATE: wallet.balance -= amount
   -> Create Transaction (type=withdrawal, fromWallet=wallet)
   -> Voucher DIRECTION_DEBIT -> markApplied(tx.uuid)

reverse(voucherUuid, reason)
  |
  v
1. Voucher must be APPLIED + DIRECTION_DEBIT
2. Within DB transaction
   -> Lock wallet
   -> DQL UPDATE: wallet.balance += amount
   -> Create Transaction (type=debit_reversal, toWallet=wallet)
   -> voucher->markReversed(tx.uuid, reason)
3. provider.reverse(voucher, reason) hook

Both operations are atomic (rollback + EM recovery on failure) and idempotent by referenceId. The provider tag is wallet.withdraw_provider; ManualWithdrawProvider is the built-in no-op authorization.

权限控制由提供商拥有。 每个提供商都实现 assertPermitted(array $options) 并可以使用 AccessDeniedException 拒绝（映射到 HTTP 403）。手册提供者要求ROLE_ADMIN；如果没有活动的安全上下文（CLI/队列/系统调用），该调用将被视为受信任的内部调用者并被允许。外部提供商实施自己的规则。

docs.title: 5.1 验证余额()
docs.text:
检查会计不变量： 

SUM(all wallet balances) == SUM(all deposit + adjustment transactions)

返回{totalBalance, totalDeposited, discrepancy, matches, walletCount}。

docs.title: 5.2 协调()
docs.text:
每个钱包对账：

  1. 对于每个钱包，根据交易历史计算expected = SUM(credits) - SUM(debits)
  2. 将实际余额与预期余额进行比较
  3. 如果actual > expected：创建TYPE_ADJUSTMENT存款（确认遗留余额）
  4. 如果actual < expected：报告为skipped_negative（需要人工审核）
  5. 不影响钱包余额 — 仅创建调整交易记录
  6. 幂等 — 当帐目平衡时重新运行会产生 0 调整

返回{reconciled, adjustments[]}。

docs.title: 6.异常设计
docs.text:
例外 当被抛出时 InsufficientFundsException 源钱包余额<转账金额 WalletFrozenException 钱包状态为 frozen SameWalletTransferException fromWalletId == toWalletId

所有异常都扩展\RuntimeException。

docs.title: 7. 支付集成
docs.text: 钱包通过支付定义的接口与支付集成。钱包拥有钱包特定的行为和数据，而支付拥有发票工作流程和网关编排。

docs.title: 7.1 依赖方向
docs.text: 来自 至 允许 规则 钱包 付款 是的 实施支付网关和调整提供商接口 付款 钱包 没有 付款不得导入钱包服务或扣款实体 钱包 贸易 没有 钱包不得直接对交易订单做出反应

docs.title: 7.2 钱包网关
docs.text:
WalletGateway 是 Wallet 拥有的支付网关实现。它处理完全通过钱包余额支付的发票。

文件：src/Wallet/Service/Payment/WalletGateway.php

合约：实现App\Payment\Service\PaymentGatewayInterface

规则：

规则 要求 WPG-1 网关从 Payment 接收明确的金额并准确转移该金额 WPG-2 网关不得检查钱包扣除或调整选项 WPG-3 网关使用TransferServiceInterface::transfer()从付款人钱包到系统钱包 WPG-4 网关退款从系统钱包转回付款人钱包 WPG-5 每次发票/退款尝试时网关引用都是稳定且幂等的

WalletGateway 与钱包余额扣除是分开的。钱包网关通过钱包作为所选付款方式支付发票。钱包余额扣除是一种预付款调整，可以与其他网关结合使用。

docs.title: 7.3 WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider
docs.text:
WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider 在网关付款之前应用钱包余额作为付款调整。

文件：src/Wallet/Service/Payment/WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider.php

合约：实现App\Payment\Service\Adjustment\PaymentAdjustmentProviderInterface

提供商名称：wallet_balance

支持的请求选项：

输入 意义 walletAmount 发票币种的快捷金额 deduction.type = wallet_balance 结构化调整请求 deduction.amount 扣除金额（以分为单位） deduction.currency 必须等于发票币种 systemWalletId 系统钱包收到扣款

提供者的责任：

责任 详情 supports() 当存在 walletAmount > 0 或结构化 deduction.type = wallet_balance 时返回 true apply() 将付款人钱包余额转入系统钱包并保存 PaymentDeduction applied() 将应用的扣除额返回为 PaymentAdjustmentResult 以进行付款金额验证 release() 当发票付款失败或在付款前被取消时，反向应用扣除 refund() 已付款发票退款时反向应用的扣除额

提供商仅向 Payment 返回通用付款调整数据：

new PaymentAdjustmentResult(
    provider: 'wallet_balance',
    amount: $deduction->getAmount(),
    currency: $deduction->getCurrency(),
    referenceId: $deduction->getReferenceId(),
    payload: [
        'deductionId' => $deduction->getUuid(),
    ],
);

钱包交易 ID 可以存储在 PaymentDeduction 中，但 Payment 不得依赖它们。

docs.title: 7.4 推演流程
docs.text:
InvoiceService::pay(invoice, payment, options)
  -> PaymentAdjustmentRegistry finds WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider
  -> WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider::apply(context)
     -> find payer wallet by payer id and invoice currency
     -> transfer payer wallet -> system wallet
     -> persist PaymentDeduction as applied
     -> return PaymentAdjustmentResult(amount=walletAmount)
  -> Payment computes gatewayAmount = invoice.amount - adjustmentTotal
  -> Payment calls selected gateway with explicit gatewayAmount

钱包全扣：

walletAmount == invoice.amount
  -> WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider applies transfer
  -> Payment marks invoice paid with payment = wallet
  -> no external gateway is called

docs.title: 7.5 释放和退款流程
docs.text:
发票付款前释放：

gateway pay creation fails or invoice is cancelled
  -> Payment calls WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider::release(result, reason)
  -> Wallet transfers system wallet -> payer wallet
  -> PaymentDeduction status becomes released

支付发票后退款：

InvoiceService::refund(full invoice amount)
  -> Payment refunds external gateway amount first, if any
  -> Payment calls WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider::refund(result, reason)
  -> Wallet transfers system wallet -> payer wallet
  -> PaymentDeduction status becomes refunded

第一阶段钱包扣款仅支持发票全额退款。外部网关金额和钱包扣除之间的部分退款分配超出了范围。

docs.title: 7.6 参考 ID
docs.text:
钱包扣款转账必须使用稳定的幂等性引用：

invoice-adjustment-wallet-balance-{invoice.uuid}
invoice-adjustment-wallet-balance-release-{invoice.uuid}
invoice-adjustment-wallet-balance-refund-{invoice.uuid}

这些引用被传递到 TransferServiceInterface::transfer() 并存储在 PaymentDeduction 中。

docs.title: 9. Concurrency Contract — Pessimistic Lock + Manual Version
docs.text:
Wallets use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (pessimistic locking) with a manually incremented version column. There is no #[ORM\Version] mapping:

  • TransferService / DepositService / WithdrawService lock the target wallet row(s) FOR UPDATE in a deterministic order, validate, then UPDATE wallet SET balance = ..., version = version + 1
  • Concurrent transactions block on the row lock; the loser re-reads the updated balance after the winner commits
  • version is an ordinary int used for audit ordering, not for Doctrine optimistic-lock checks
  • Do not add #[ORM\Version] without a documented architectural decision

    S2 -->|"Miss"| M["new User()<br/>email: wx_{openid_suffix}@wechat.local<br/>username: wx_{openid_suffix}<br/>password: random_bytes(32) + bin2hex"]
    M --> M2["new WechatUser(user, openid, ...)<br/>em->persist(user), em->persist(wechatUser)"]
    S1 --> S2
    H --> FL["em->flush()"]
    M2 --> FL
    FL --> R["return User"]

Design decision: random password for new Users — WeChat users don't need a password; a JWT is issued directly. A random password prevents privilege escalation through password-login vulnerabilities.

docs.title: POST /api/wechat/miniapp/login — Mini Program login (PUBLIC_ACCESS)
docs.text:
Request:  { "js_code": "081abc..." }
Response: { "access_token": "...", "expires_in": 7200, "refresh_token": "..." }

Errors:
  400 — js_code missing
  401 — WeChat API returned error (invalid code)

#[Route('/miniapp/login', methods: ['POST'])]
public function miniappLogin(Request $request): JsonResponse
{
    $data = json_decode($request->getContent(), true);
    $jsCode = trim((string) ($data['js_code'] ?? ''));
    if ($jsCode === '') {
        return $this->error('js_code is required.', 400);
    }
    try {
        $user = $this->wechatAuthService->authenticateFromMiniApp($jsCode);
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        return $this->error($e->getMessage(), 401);
    }
    return $this->tokenResponse($user);
}

docs.text:
Request:  { "code": "xxx" }
Response: 204 No Content

Errors:
  400 — code missing
  401 — WeChat API error

#[Route('/miniapp/phone', methods: ['POST'])]
public function miniappPhone(Request $request): JsonResponse
{
    $data = json_decode($request->getContent(), true);
    $code = trim((string) ($data['code'] ?? ''));
    if ($code === '') {
        return $this->error('code is required.', 400);
    }
    try {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = $this->getUser();
        $this->wechatAuthService->bindPhone($user, $code);
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        return $this->error($e->getMessage(), 401);
    }
    return new JsonResponse(null, 204);
}

#[Route('/oauth/url', methods: ['GET'])]
public function oauthUrl(Request $request): JsonResponse
{
    $redirectUri = trim((string) $request->query->get('redirect_uri', ''));
    if ($redirectUri === '') {
        return $this->error('redirect_uri is required.', 400);
    }
    $url = $this->wechatService->getOAuthRedirectUrl($redirectUri);
    return new JsonResponse(['url' => $url]);
}

#[Route('/oauth/callback', methods: ['POST'])]
public function oauthCallback(Request $request): JsonResponse
{
    $data = json_decode($request->getContent(), true);
    $code = trim((string) ($data['code'] ?? ''));
    if ($code === '') {
        return $this->error('code is required.', 400);
    }
    try {
        $user = $this->wechatAuthService->authenticateFromOfficialAccount($code);
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        return $this->error($e->getMessage(), 401);
    }
    return $this->tokenResponse($user);
}

docs.title: Private helpers
docs.text:
private function tokenResponse(User $user): JsonResponse
{
    return new JsonResponse([
        'access_token'  => $this->tokenManager->createAccessToken($user),
        'expires_in'    => $this->tokenManager->getAccessTtl(),
        'refresh_token' => $this->tokenManager->createRefreshToken($user),
    ]);
}

private function error(string $message, int $status = 400): JsonResponse
{
    return new JsonResponse(['code' => $status, 'message' => $message], $status);
}

docs.title: 架构审查问题 - 2026-06-26
docs.text: 本文档记录了在审查 docs/ai/context.md 和当前代码库期间发现的架构和生产就绪性问题。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
整体模块化架构对于 Symfony API 框架来说是合理的。模块边界清晰，Core提供可重用的CRUD/API基础设施，业务模块按领域分隔，支付网关、定价计算器、工作流程和领域事件等扩展点与项目目标很好地契合。

主要风险不是结构性故障，而是默认暴露的过于广泛的通用功能、需要收紧的生产安全边界以及围绕支付流的交易边界。

docs.title: 1.微信支付网关可能未注册
docs.text:
影响： 即使WechatPayGateway实现了PaymentGatewayInterface，payment=wechat也可能因PaymentGatewayNotFoundException而失败。

证据：

  • PaymentGatewayRegistry仅收集标记有payment.gateway：src/Payment/Service/PaymentGatewayRegistry.php的服务。
  • config/services.yaml 将 src/Wechat/Service/Gateway/WechatPayGateway.php 从全局 App\ 服务资源中排除。
  • src/Wechat/Resources/config/services_wechat.yaml显式定义WechatPayGateway，但不添加payment.gateway标签。

推荐：

在 services_wechat.yaml 中添加显式标签：

App\Wechat\Service\Gateway\WechatPayGateway:
    arguments:
        $notifyUrl: '%env(WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL)%'
    tags: ['payment.gateway']

或者，在 PaymentGatewayInterface 的微信服务配置中添加 _instanceof 规则。

docs.title: 2. /system/* 内省端点实际上是公开的
docs.text:
影响： 实体元数据和路由结构可以在生产中公开。

证据：

  • 系统控制器在/system下路由，例如src/Core/Controller/System/EntityController.php。
  • 配置的API防火墙仅匹配config/packages/security.yaml中的^/api。
  • access_control规则仅限制/api路径，不覆盖/system。

推荐：

选择以下方法之一：

  1. 将系统路由移至 /api/system 下，以便应用 API 防火墙。
  2. 为需要 ROLE_ADMIN 的 ^/system 添加显式 access_control 规则。
  3. 在生产中禁用系统路由并使其仅用于开发/测试。

docs.title: 3.动态查询功能对于默认的公共API使用来说太强大了
docs.text:
影响： 客户端可以提交原始或接近原始的查询控件，这会增加数据暴露和性能风险。

证据：

  • @dql 从请求中读取并传递到 BaseServiceReadListTrait 中的 Doctrine 查询创建。
  • 请求参数还支持@select、@groupBy、@hints和@showDQL。
  • ListApiViewMixin 记录所有通用列表端点的这些参数。

推荐：

引入查询参数的能力级别：

  • 公共/应用程序端点：仅允许 page、limit、受限 @order 和安全 @filter。
  • 管理端点：可选择为管理员提供更丰富的查询功能。
  • 仅调试/开发：允许 @dql、@hints 和 @showDQL。

另请考虑从生成的公共 OpenAPI 文档中删除这些危险参数。

docs.title: 4.支付和钱包交易边界需要收紧
docs.text:
影响： 数据库事务打开时可能会执行外部支付调用。如果没有明确的保存点支持，嵌套钱包交易可能不会按预期运行。

证据：

  • InvoiceService::pay() 打开一个事务，然后在其中调用 $gateway->pay()。
  • WechatPayGateway::pay()执行出站微信API调用。
  • TransferService手动启动与beginTransaction()的事务。
  • Trade\Controller\Manage\OrderController 中的注释假设嵌套保存点行为，但未找到显式 Doctrine 保存点配置。

推荐：

独立的本地和外部支付流程：

  • 钱包网关：保持本地余额移动和发票状态更新原子性。
  • 微信等外部网关：将发票保留为paying，提交，调用提供商，然后通过回调/通知完成。
  • 如果需要嵌套事务，请显式启用并测试保存点行为。

docs.title: 5.应用程序订单生命周期可能不完整
docs.text:
影响： 应用用户可以在draft中创建订单，但付款要求订单能够从confirmed转换为paid。

证据：

  • Order初始状态为draft。
  • 工作流程需要draft -> pending -> confirmed -> paid。
  • 应用程序付款操作检查workflow->can($order, 'pay')。
  • 未找到用于提交/确认的应用程序端点。

推荐：

明确预期的业务流程：

  • 如果需要管理员确认，请清楚地记录下来。
  • 如果用户需要立即付款，请直接创建订单作为confirmed，或添加应用程序提交流程，将订单移至应付状态。

docs.title: 6. BaseService 将服务逻辑与请求级关注点混合在一起
docs.text:
影响： 服务类变得更难在 HTTP 外部重用，并且更难在测试或 CLI 上下文中进行推理。

证据：

  • BaseService 从令牌存储中捕获当前用户。
  • BaseServiceReadListTrait::list() 从当前请求中读取查询参数。
  • 查询语法、请求过滤、Doctrine、序列化和验证集中在基础服务层。

推荐：

随着时间的推移，将请求解析移向控制器或专用查询 DTO/查询构建器对象。让服务方法专注于显式输入和域操作。

docs.title: 7. BaseService::new() 可以绕过实体构造函数
docs.text:
影响： 具有所需构造函数不变量的实体可能会在无效状态下创建。

证据：

  • 当实体构造函数具有必需参数时，BaseServiceMutationTrait::new() 使用newInstanceWithoutConstructor()。
  • Wallet 在其构造函数中需要 User 和货币。

推荐：

对具有所需不变量的实体使用专用工厂/创建方法。避免公开这些实体的通用创建端点，除非控制器安全地构造它们。

docs.title: 8.分页没有最大限制
docs.text:
影响： 客户端可能会请求非常大的 limit，从而导致大量的数据库查询或大量的序列化响应。

证据：

  • RestController::pagination() 使用带有默认 100 的 max(1, request limit)，但不限制上限。

推荐：

添加全局最大值，例如 min(200, max(1, $request->query->getInt('limit', 100)))，或使最大值可配置。

docs.title: 9.内存回退过滤可能会加载太多数据
docs.text:
影响： 如果 DQL 编译失败，该服务会在 PHP 中加载完整的结果集和筛选器，这对于大型表来说可能会很昂贵。

证据：

  • 当过滤器编译失败或使用 @sort 时，BaseServiceReadListTrait::list() 回退到 $query->getResult()，然后是 array_filter()。

推荐：

对于生产 API 端点，当过滤器编译失败时，使用 400 Bad Request 快速失败。仅针对开发/调试或显式较小的集合保留内存中回退。

docs.title: 10. 通用 OpenAPI 文档公开实现控制
docs.text:
影响： 公共 API 文档宣传内部查询控件，例如 @dql、@hints 和 @showDQL。

推荐：

按端点类型拆分 OpenAPI 参数文档或从通用 mixin 文档中删除危险控件。

docs.title: 11. 服务接线具有重复的网关标记约定
docs.text:
影响： src/Payment/Service/Gateway/下的支付网关由根_instanceof规则和services_payment.yaml同时标记，而微信网关是单独定义的，目前没有标记。

推荐：

将网关标记集中在一个一致的约定中，最好是所有导入的模块服务配置的 _instanceof PaymentGatewayInterface。
